chunks: And some of them will confront the others, asking each other.

key_terms.يَتَسَاءَلُونَ: they ask each other / mutual questioning

ai.seo_question: What does it mean when people confront each other and ask questions on the Day of Judgment?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this scene highlights the psychological torment of the disbelievers as they confront one another, seeking validation for their denial that ultimately proves futile. It underscores the theme of mutual accountability, where individuals realize that their companions in sin cannot offer any intercession or relief on that Day. This moment serves as a stark reminder of the isolation of the soul when stripped of divine mercy.
